SUMMARY
Data analyst with 4 years of experience turning sales and operations data into dashboards and decisions. Comfortable
owning analyses end to end, from SQL extraction to stakeholder presentations.

Pune, India

Pune, India

jd:
Senior Data Analyst — Lumen Analytics (Pune, hybrid)

Lumen Analytics helps mid-size retailers understand their customers. We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Insights team and own analyses from question to recommendation.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau that leadership uses every week
- Write complex SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse
- Design, run and analyse A/B tests with the product team
- Build forecasting models in Python (pandas, scikit-learn)
- Present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders
- Mentor two junior analysts

What we're looking for (required)
- 4+ years of experience in a data analyst or similar role
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field
- Expert SQL and strong Python
- Experience with a BI tool (Power BI or Tableau)
- Experience designing and analysing A/B tests

Nice to have
- Snowflake or dbt experience
- Retail or e-commerce domain knowledge
- Airflow or another orchestration tool
- Experience mentoring other analysts

analysis.fitRationale: Priya is a strong fit for this position as she meets all mandatory experience, education, and hard skill criteria. She works in Pune (matching the job location), has a B.Sc. in Statistics, brings 4 years of retail analytics experience, and has proven success with SQL, Python, Tableau, and A/B testing. Her main gaps are nice-to-haves: Snowflake/dbt experience and explicit mentorship details.
strengths: Meets the gating minimums of 4 years of experience and a B.Sc. in Statistics.
Direct retail domain experience aligned with Lumen Analytics' core client base.
Proven experience building weekly production dashboards in Tableau and running conversion A/B tests.
Location match in Pune, India for a hybrid work model.
Quantified achievements demonstrating clear business impact.
gaps: No exposure to Snowflake or dbt listed on the resume.
Lacks explicit details on Python libraries (pandas, scikit-learn) in the Skills section.
Forecasting is currently shown via Excel models rather than Python.
No explicit bullet point showing mentorship of junior analysts or peers.
